post.summary: Creates a draft `text` item or assignment as the last item of a module or sub-module.
post.description:
`body` is a JSON object that is stored and returned as is; an array or a string is rejected.
For an assignment it holds the instructions.

`kind: assignment` requires an `assignment` object `{type, config?, max_points, is_bonus?}`
(ADR-0021); a `text` item must not carry one. `type` is `text`, `no_submission`, `quiz` or `form`; the
`config` of a `quiz` is its questions and must add up to `max_points` (ADR-0050), that of a `form` its
fields (ADR-0051), and the others take an empty one (a `text` assignment may narrow its editor).
`max_points` is a decimal string such as `"20"` or `"7.5"`; a JSON number is rejected. The
grading scale limits the points (ADR-0022): at most 12 per assignment on `twelve`, at most
100 in total over the regular (not bonus) assignments of the course on `hundred`.

term_id.description: An existing term; `null` clears it; absent changes nothing. A template has no term.

accept_late.description: Assignments only. Omit to keep, `null` to clear.

oneOf.description: A block document that replaces the body. Omit (or send `null`) to keep it.

class_on.description:
`no_submission` assignments only (ADR-0049). Omit to keep, `null` to clear, a day
(`YYYY-MM-DD`) to set.

config.description: Assignments only: replaces the config. Omit to keep it.

due_at.description:
Assignments only (ADR-0035). Omit to keep, `null` to clear, a timestamp to set. The rules
are checked on the resulting settings: to remove a deadline send `due_at`, `on_deadline`
and `accept_late` as `null` together.

is_bonus.description: Assignments only. Omit to keep it.

late_until.description: Assignments only. Omit to keep, `null` to clear.

max_attempts.description: Assignments only. Omit to keep, `null` for unlimited attempts, a number of at least 1 to set.

max_points.description: Assignments only: a decimal string, see `NewAssignment`. Omit to keep it.

on_deadline.description: Assignments only. Omit to keep, `null` to clear, `keep_draft` or `auto_submit` to set.

publish_at.description: Omit to keep, `null` to clear, a timestamp to set.
Omit to keep, `null` to clear, a timestamp to set.

UpdateTermRequest.description: Only the fields present change; the dates are checked together after the merge.

UserFacts.description: What one person does in the institution.

last_login_at.description: `null` until the person signs in after the server learned to record it.

studies.description: Published courses where they are a current student.

teaches.description: Regular courses where they are a teacher or an assistant but not the owner.

UserSummary.description: People by institution role, and how many are disabled.

VerifyEmailRequest.description: The token from the verification mail.

video_id.description: A YouTube id is 11 characters from `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`; a Vimeo id is 1 to 12 digits.

VideoProvider.description: The client builds the embed address from a fixed template; the server stores no URL.

WorkCourse.description: A course a student studies in.

WorkItem.description: One assignment and the caller's own standing on it. Only published values appear.

class_on.description: The day an in-class assignment takes place, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

score.description: The published score, a decimal string with two decimals.

WorkStatus.description: Where a student stands on an assignment.

bearer.description: A session token from `POST /auth/login` with `client: app`.
